questions.label: Dated printed-book claim held for source-year verification; unscored and not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుట 487లో fishing villages, landing centres/harbours, GDP share, growth rate, exportsకు ఇచ్చిన figuresను current factగా వాడే ముందు సరైన పద్ధతి ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct method before using the page-487 figures for fishing villages, landing centres or harbours, GDP share, growth and exports as current facts?
options_te: ప్రతి figureకు year, definition, unit, official seriesను విడిగా నిర్ధారించడం
అన్నీ ఒకే 2019–20 table నుంచి వచ్చాయని ఊహించడం
options_en: Verify the year, definition, unit and official series separately for every figure
Assume all figures come from one 2019–20 table
Combine harbours and villages into one unit
questions.explanation_te: ఈ figures వేర్వేరు reference periods, definitionsకు చెందినవిగా ఉండవచ్చు. 2018–19 export valueను 2019–20 GDP shareతో కలిపి ఒకే-year factగా చూపరాదు; infrastructure countsకూ classification అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: These figures may belong to different reference periods and definitions. The 2018–19 export value must not be presented as a single-year fact with a 2019–20 GDP share; infrastructure counts also require classification.
option_explanations_en: Proximity in print does not prove a common source year.
questions.source_paragraph: current exam factగా score చేయడానికి Department of Fisheries handbook లేదా Economic Surveyలో year, unit, categoryను తిరిగి నిర్ధారించాలి.
options: ప్రతి figureకు year, definition, unit, official seriesను విడిగా నిర్ధారించడం
అన్నీ ఒకే 2019–20 table నుంచి వచ్చాయని ఊహించడం

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: తేనెటీగల పెంపకం (Apiculture) వ్యవసాయానికి అందించే ప్రయోజనాన్ని అత్యంత సమగ్రంగా తెలిపేది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which option most comprehensively states the agricultural value of apiculture?
options_te: తేనె, తేనె మైనంతో పాటు పరాగసంపర్క సేవ ద్వారా కొన్ని పంటల్లో పండ్లు లేదా విత్తనాలు ఏర్పడటానికి సహాయం
తేనె మాత్రమే; పంట ఉత్పత్తితో సంబంధం లేదు
తేనె మైనం మాత్రమే; పుష్పించే మొక్కల ప్రభావం లేదు
ప్రతి ప్రాంతంలో ఒకే bee species, ఒకే output తప్పనిసరి
options_en: Honey and beeswax, plus pollination services that support fruit or seed set in some crops
Honey alone, with no relation to crop production
Beeswax alone, unaffected by flowering plants
The same bee species and output are compulsory in every region
questions.explanation_te: తేనెటీగల పెంపకం (Apiculture) productsతో పాటు పరాగసంపర్క సేవ (Pollination Service)ను అందిస్తుంది. ఫలితం climate, flowering flora, bee species, colony health, managementను బట్టి మారుతుంది.
questions.explanation_en: Apiculture provides products and pollination services. Outcomes vary with climate, flowering flora, bee species, colony health and management.
option_explanations_te: సరైంది; products, ecosystem service రెండూ ఉన్నాయి.
option_explanations_en: Correct; it includes products and an ecosystem service.
questions.source_paragraph: కూడా ముఖ్యమైనది. కొన్ని పంటల్లో ఇది పండ్లు లేదా విత్తనాలు ఏర్పడటానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.
options: తేనె, తేనె మైనంతో పాటు పరాగసంపర్క సేవ ద్వారా కొన్ని పంటల్లో పండ్లు లేదా విత్తనాలు ఏర్పడటానికి సహాయం
తేనె మాత్రమే; పంట ఉత్పత్తితో సంబంధం లేదు
తేనె మైనం మాత్రమే; పుష్పించే మొక్కల ప్రభావం లేదు
ప్రతి ప్రాంతంలో ఒకే bee species, ఒకే output తప్పనిసరి
option_explanations: సరైంది; products, ecosystem service రెండూ ఉన్నాయి.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: తేనెటీగల పెంపకం (Apiculture), Apis గురించి సరైన వివరణ ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement correctly describes apiculture and Apis?
options_te: Apiculture అనేది managed beekeeping; Apis అనేది honey-bee genusకు ఉపయోగించే శాస్త్రీయ పేరు
Apis అంటే ప్రతి pollinating insect; Apiculture అంటే silk production
Apiculture అంటే wild honey collection మాత్రమే
options_en: Apiculture is managed beekeeping; Apis is a scientific genus used for honey bees
Apis means every pollinating insect; apiculture means silk production
questions.explanation_te: Apicultureలో coloniesను నిర్వహిస్తారు. Apis honey-bee genus; ప్రపంచంలోని ప్రతి bee species Apis కాదు. Sericulture మాత్రం silkworm rearing.
questions.explanation_en: Apiculture involves managed bee colonies. Apis is a honey-bee genus; not every bee species belongs to Apis. Sericulture concerns silkworm rearing.
option_explanations_en: Apis is not a crop genus.
questions.source_paragraph: అనేది honey-bee genusకు ఉపయోగించే శాస్త్రీయ పేరు; ప్రతి bee species అదే genusకు చెందదు.
options: Apiculture అనేది managed beekeeping; Apis అనేది honey-bee genusకు ఉపయోగించే శాస్త్రీయ పేరు
Apis అంటే ప్రతి pollinating insect; Apiculture అంటే silk production
Apiculture అంటే wild honey collection మాత్రమే

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Assertion (A): పాలీహౌస్ (Polyhouse)లో రక్షిత సాగు (Protected Cultivation) పంట సూక్ష్మ వాతావరణాన్ని (Microclimate) కొంతవరకు మార్చగలదు. Reason (R): Cover, ventilation, shade, irrigationతో temperature, humidity, light, air movementను నిర్వహించవచ్చు.
questions.question_en: Assertion (A): Protected cultivation in a polyhouse can partly modify the crop microclimate. Reason (R): Cover, ventilation, shade and irrigation can manage temperature, humidity, light and air movement.
options_te: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు వివరణ కాదు
options_en: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.explanation_te: Coverతో పాటు ventilation, shade, irrigation వంటి controls వల్ల crop microclimateను కొంతవరకు నిర్వహించవచ్చు. అందువల్ల R, Aకు mechanismను వివరిస్తుంది.
questions.explanation_en: Cover together with ventilation, shade and irrigation permits partial management of crop microclimate. Therefore R explains the mechanism in A.
questions.source_paragraph: ను కొంతవరకు నిర్వహిస్తారు. దీనిని
options: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు వివరణ కాదు

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Protected Cultivationలో polyhouse నిర్మించిన వెంటనే అధిక yield హామీ కాదని చెప్పడానికి సరైన కారణాల సమూహం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which set of reasons correctly explains why building a polyhouse does not automatically guarantee high yield?
options_te: Ventilation, temperature, irrigation, pests, diseases, skill, capital, market management అవసరం
Transparent cover ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన అన్ని crops సమానంగా పెరుగుతాయి
Water, nutrients, disease monitoring అవసరం ఉండదు
options_en: Ventilation, temperature, irrigation, pests, diseases, skill, capital and market management are required
A transparent cover makes all crops grow equally
Outdoor climate has no influence at all
Water, nutrients and disease monitoring are unnecessary
questions.explanation_te: Polyhouse ఒక management tool; biological needs, local climate, structure design, technical operation, economicsను భర్తీ చేయదు. తప్పు నిర్వహణ heat, humidity, pest లేదా disease problemsను పెంచవచ్చు.
questions.explanation_en: A polyhouse is a management tool; it does not replace biological needs, local climate, structural design, technical operation or economics. Poor management can worsen heat, humidity, pest or disease problems.
option_explanations_en: These inputs and monitoring remain necessary.
questions.source_paragraph: structure ఒక్కటే yieldకు హామీ కాదు.
options: Ventilation, temperature, irrigation, pests, diseases, skill, capital, market management అవసరం
Transparent cover ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన అన్ని crops సమానంగా పెరుగుతాయి
Water, nutrients, disease monitoring అవసరం ఉండదు

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: రంగు విప్లవాలను వాటి విస్తృతంగా స్థిరపడిన రంగాలతో జతపరచండి. A. Green; B. White; C. Blue; D. Yellow. 1. Milk; 2. Foodgrains; 3. Oilseeds; 4. Fisheries.
questions.question_en: Match the colour revolutions with their widely established sectors. A. Green; B. White; C. Blue; D. Yellow. 1. Milk; 2. Foodgrains; 3. Oilseeds; 4. Fisheries.
questions.explanation_te: Green–foodgrains, White–milk, Blue–fisheries, Yellow–oilseeds విస్తృతంగా ఉపయోగించే జతలు. Programme year లేదా detailed scope అడిగితే official source అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: Green–foodgrains, White–milk, Blue–fisheries and Yellow–oilseeds are widely used pairings. An official source is still needed for programme years or detailed scope.
questions.source_paragraph: Foodgrains, ముఖ్యంగా wheat–rice productivity transformation

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: సతత హరిత విప్లవం (Evergreen Revolution) భావనను సరైన విధంగా తెలిపేది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement correctly describes the idea of an Evergreen Revolution?
options_te: Ecological harm పెంచకుండా productivityను sustainableగా పెంచడం
Greenhouse coversను green colourలో తయారు చేయడం
options_en: Sustainably increasing productivity without increasing ecological harm
Making greenhouse covers green in colour
Continuously expanding only the foodgrain area
questions.explanation_te: Evergreen Revolution productivity, resource conservation, ecological sustainabilityను కలపాలనే భావన. ఇది ఒక crop, colour, fixed launch yearకు పరిమితం కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: The Evergreen Revolution concept combines productivity with resource conservation and ecological sustainability. It is not confined to one crop, colour or fixed launch year.
option_explanations_en: This treats the term as a literal colour.
It is not merely area expansion.
It is contrary to unlimited input use.
questions.source_paragraph: Ecological harm పెంచకుండా productivityను sustainableగా పెంచాలనే భావన
options: Ecological harm పెంచకుండా productivityను sustainableగా పెంచడం
Greenhouse coversను green colourలో తయారు చేయడం

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Colour Revolution tablesను ఉపయోగించేటప్పుడు సరైన పద్ధతి ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the sound approach when using colour-revolution tables?
options_te: Widely established pairsను contextతో ఉపయోగించి, Brown, Grey, Pink, Red వంటి మారే labelsకు source లేదా official key చూడాలి
ప్రతి coaching list ఒకే official taxonomy అని భావించాలి
Horticulture, Pisciculture వంటి ప్రతి production term colour revolution అని భావించాలి
ప్రతి colourకు అన్ని sourcesలో ఒకే product తప్పనిసరి
options_en: Use widely established pairs with context, and check a source or official key for variable labels such as Brown, Grey, Pink and Red
Treat every coaching list as the same official taxonomy
Treat every production term such as horticulture or pisciculture as a colour revolution
Assume every colour must denote the same product in all sources
questions.explanation_te: Colour labels formal scientific taxonomy కాదు. Horticulture, Pisciculture, Mariculture, Apiculture, Sericulture, Vermicultureకు స్వతంత్ర definitions ఉన్నాయి. Variable coloursను official context లేకుండా score చేయరాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Colour labels are not a formal scientific taxonomy. Horticulture, pisciculture, mariculture, apiculture, sericulture and vermiculture have independent definitions. Variable colours should not be scored without official context.
option_explanations_en: There is no single universal list.
A production system differs from a colour label.
questions.source_paragraph: Colour Revolution labels శాస్త్రీయ classification కాదు.
options: Widely established pairsను contextతో ఉపయోగించి, Brown, Grey, Pink, Red వంటి మారే labelsకు source లేదా official key చూడాలి
ప్రతి coaching list ఒకే official taxonomy అని భావించాలి
Horticulture, Pisciculture వంటి ప్రతి production term colour revolution అని భావించాలి
ప్రతి colourకు అన్ని sourcesలో ఒకే product తప్పనిసరి

questions.label: Printed or dated claim held for source verification; unscored and not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుట 488లో honey productionలో China first, Argentina second, India fifth అని ముద్రించిన rankను current factగా score చేయడానికి ముందు ఏమి అవసరం?
questions.question_en: What is required before scoring the printed page-488 ranking of China first, Argentina second and India fifth in honey production as a current fact?
options_te: Reference year, product definition, unit, official international dataset
options_en: Reference year, product definition, unit and an official international dataset
Deriving the rank from the number of bee species
Removing the year and treating the rank as permanent
questions.explanation_te: Honey production ranks కాలానుగుణం. Natural honey, other bee products, production quantity, trade exports వేర్వేరు series; year, metric లేకుండా rank defensible కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Honey-production ranks are time-bound. Natural honey, other bee products, production quantity and trade exports are different series; a rank is not defensible without year and metric.
option_explanations_en: The rank is incomplete without metadata.
Species diversity is not a production rank.
questions.source_paragraph: rankను year–datasetతో నిర్ధారించిన తరువాతే current scoring factగా వాడాలి.
options: Reference year, product definition, unit, official international dataset

questions.label: Printed or dated claim held for source verification; unscored and not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుట 488లో Kashmir Valleyలో 9,000 poly greenhouses ఉన్నాయని ముద్రించిన claimను ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి?
questions.question_en: How should the printed claim of 9,000 poly greenhouses in the Kashmir Valley be used?
options_te: Scheme year, structure definition, official horticulture reportతో verify అయ్యే వరకు historical printed claimగా మాత్రమే
Current national totalగా నేరుగా score చేయాలి
Indiaలో polyhouse సంఖ్యకు permanent minimumగా తీసుకోవాలి
options_en: Treat it only as a historical printed claim until verified by scheme year, structure definition and an official horticulture report
Score it directly as the current national total
Treat it as a permanent minimum for India
Treat it as direct proof of crop yield
questions.explanation_te: Structure count scheme implementationతో మారుతుంది; polyhouse, greenhouse, low tunnel definitions కూడా reportల మధ్య మారవచ్చు. Exact numberకు year, geography, scheme and official count అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: Structure counts change with programme implementation, and definitions of polyhouse, greenhouse and low tunnel can vary. An exact number requires year, geography, scheme and an official count.
option_explanations_te: ఇది Kashmir claim; national total కాదు.
option_explanations_en: This is a Kashmir claim, not a national total.
It is not a permanent minimum.
A structure count does not prove yield.
questions.source_paragraph: Kashmir Valleyలో 9,000 poly greenhouses
options: Scheme year, structure definition, official horticulture reportతో verify అయ్యే వరకు historical printed claimగా మాత్రమే
Current national totalగా నేరుగా score చేయాలి
Indiaలో polyhouse సంఖ్యకు permanent minimumగా తీసుకోవాలి
option_explanations: ఇది Kashmir claim; national total కాదు.

questions.label: Printed or dated claim held for source verification; unscored and not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుటలు 487–488లో shrimp farmingకు ఇచ్చిన 75%, Thailand export lead, Nellore prominence claimsపై సరైన treatment ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct treatment of the page 487–488 claims about 75% shrimp farming, Thailand export leadership and Nellore prominence?
options_te: Species, year, production/export metric, official datasetతో verify చేసి మాత్రమే rank లేదా shareగా score చేయాలి
మూడింటినీ timeless universal factsగా score చేయాలి
Production, exports, district importance ఒకే indicator అని భావించాలి
options_en: Score them as ranks or shares only after verifying species, year, production or export metric and an official dataset
Score all three as timeless universal facts
Treat production, exports and district importance as one indicator
questions.explanation_te: Asia production share, country export rank, district production importance మూడు వేర్వేరు measures. Reference year, shrimp category, unit, source లేకుండా వాటిని కలపడం లేదా currentగా score చేయడం సరికాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Asian production share, country export rank and district production importance are three different measures. They should not be merged or scored as current without reference year, shrimp category, unit and source.
questions.source_paragraph: reference year, species, production/export dataset లేకుండా current ranksగా score చేయరాదు.
options: Species, year, production/export metric, official datasetతో verify చేసి మాత్రమే rank లేదా shareగా score చేయాలి
మూడింటినీ timeless universal factsగా score చేయాలి
Production, exports, district importance ఒకే indicator అని భావించాలి

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: సహజ వ్యవసాయం (Natural Farming), జీవామృతం (Jeevamrit) గురించి శాస్త్రీయంగా సమతుల్యమైన statement ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which is a scientifically balanced statement about Natural Farming and Jeevamrit?
options_te: Local biological processes, farm-derived inputsకు ప్రాధాన్యం ఉంటుంది; recipes, nutrient sufficiency, outcomesను స్థానికంగా పరీక్షించాలి
ఒకే Jeevamrit recipe ప్రతి soil, cropకు అన్ని nutrientsను పూర్తిగా అందిస్తుంది
Natural Farmingలో yield, risk, labour, livelihoodను కొలవాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు
Zero Budget అనే పేరు ప్రతి రైతుకు ఖర్చు శూన్యమని నిరూపిస్తుంది
options_en: Local biological processes and farm-derived inputs are emphasised, while recipes, nutrient sufficiency and outcomes require local evaluation
One Jeevamrit recipe supplies every nutrient completely in every soil and crop
Yield, risk, labour and livelihood need not be measured in Natural Farming
The label Zero Budget proves that every farmer incurs no cost
questions.explanation_te: Natural Farming purchased inputsను తగ్గించి local processesపై దృష్టి పెట్టవచ్చు. Jeevamrit fermented microbial preparation; universal complete fertiliser అని నిరూపించబడదు. Soil health, yield stability, risk, labour, cost, livelihoodను కొలవాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Natural Farming may reduce purchased inputs and emphasise local processes. Jeevamrit is a fermented microbial preparation, not a proven universal complete fertiliser. Soil health, yield stability, risk, labour, cost and livelihood must be measured.
option_explanations_te: సరైంది; aim, evidence limits రెండూ ఉన్నాయి.
option_explanations_en: Correct; it states both the aim and evidence limits.
A promotional label is not economic proof.
questions.source_paragraph: ప్రతి soil–cropకు complete fertiliser అని భావించరాదు.
options: Local biological processes, farm-derived inputsకు ప్రాధాన్యం ఉంటుంది; recipes, nutrient sufficiency, outcomesను స్థానికంగా పరీక్షించాలి
ఒకే Jeevamrit recipe ప్రతి soil, cropకు అన్ని nutrientsను పూర్తిగా అందిస్తుంది
Natural Farmingలో yield, risk, labour, livelihoodను కొలవాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు
Zero Budget అనే పేరు ప్రతి రైతుకు ఖర్చు శూన్యమని నిరూపిస్తుంది
option_explanations: సరైంది; aim, evidence limits రెండూ ఉన్నాయి.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Natural Farming practicesను వాటి ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశాలతో జతపరచండి. A. Jeevamrit; B. Beejamrit; C. Mulching; D. Waaphasa. 1. Seed treatment; 2. Soil cover; 3. Fermented microbial preparation; 4. Soil air–moisture balance.
questions.question_en: Match the Natural Farming practices with their principal purposes. A. Jeevamrit; B. Beejamrit; C. Mulching; D. Waaphasa. 1. Seed treatment; 2. Soil cover; 3. Fermented microbial preparation; 4. Soil air–moisture balance.
questions.explanation_te: Jeevamrit microbial preparation; Beejamrit seed treatment; Mulching soil cover; Waaphasa soil pore air–moisture balanceపై దృష్టి. పేర్లు దగ్గరగా ఉన్నా functions వేరు.
questions.explanation_en: Jeevamrit is a microbial preparation; Beejamrit is a seed treatment; mulching covers soil; Waaphasa focuses on air–moisture balance in soil pores. Their functions differ.
questions.source_paragraph: ఇవి ఒకదానికొకటి సమానార్థకాలు కావు.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Mulching గురించి statementsను పరిశీలించండి. 1. Soil evaporation తగ్గించడంలో సహాయపడవచ్చు. 2. Soil temperature extremesను మితంగా చేయవచ్చు. 3. ప్రతి పరిస్థితిలో pest riskను పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. 4. Organic matterకు తోడ్పడవచ్చు. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements on mulching. 1. It can reduce soil evaporation. 2. It can moderate soil-temperature extremes. 3. It completely eliminates pest risk in every situation. 4. It can contribute organic matter. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: Mulching soil coverగా పని చేసి evaporation, weeds, temperature extremesను తగ్గించడంలో సహాయం చేయవచ్చు; organic material decomposition ద్వారా organic matterకు తోడ్పడవచ్చు. Pest risk universalగా zero కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Mulching acts as soil cover and can reduce evaporation, weeds and temperature extremes; organic mulch can add organic matter. It does not universally eliminate pest risk.
option_explanations_en: Statement 3 is false; statements 2 and 4 are also true.
All cannot be true because statement 3 is false.
questions.source_paragraph: Soil cover ద్వారా evaporation, weeds, temperature extremesను తగ్గించడంలో సహాయం

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుట 489లో ముద్రించిన Jeevamrit recipeను examలో ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి?
questions.question_en: How should the printed Jeevamrit recipe on page 489 be used in an examination?
options_te: Printed practiceగా ingredients–quantitiesను గుర్తించి, recipe continuation మరియు agronomic claimsను source/evidenceతో వేరు చేయాలి
ప్రతి soilకు complete nutrient formulaగా ప్రకటించాలి
Yield increase, zero irrigationను automatic resultగా చెప్పాలి
options_en: Recognise the printed ingredients and quantities as a practice, while separating the continuation and agronomic claims for source-based evaluation
Declare it a complete nutrient formula for every soil
Treat higher yield and zero irrigation as automatic results
Treat it as identical to Beejamrit
questions.explanation_te: పుటలో 200 L water, 10 L cow urine, 10 kg cow dung, 2 kg jaggery, 2 kg pulse flour, bund soil ముద్రించింది. Recipe existence, universal nutrient sufficiency రెండు వేర్వేరు claims.
questions.explanation_en: The page prints 200 L water, 10 L cow urine, 10 kg cow dung, 2 kg jaggery, 2 kg pulse flour and bund soil. The existence of a recipe and universal nutrient sufficiency are different claims.
option_explanations_en: This universalises the recipe without evidence.
questions.source_paragraph: 200 L water, 10 L cow urine, 10 kg cow dung, 2 kg jaggery, 2 kg pulse flour
options: Printed practiceగా ingredients–quantitiesను గుర్తించి, recipe continuation మరియు agronomic claimsను source/evidenceతో వేరు చేయాలి
ప్రతి soilకు complete nutrient formulaగా ప్రకటించాలి
Yield increase, zero irrigationను automatic resultగా చెప్పాలి

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Rainbow Revolution అనే broad expressionకు దగ్గరైన అర్థం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which meaning is closest to the broad expression Rainbow Revolution?
options_te: Crops, horticulture, livestock, fisheries, food processing వంటి sectorsలో సమగ్ర వృద్ధి
options_en: Integrated growth across crops, horticulture, livestock, fisheries and food processing
Growing one wheat variety throughout the country
questions.explanation_te: Rainbow Revolutionను multiple agriculture and allied sectorsలో coordinated development అనే broad policy expressionగా వాడారు. ఇది formal scientific taxonomy లేదా ఒక్క crop revolution కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Rainbow Revolution has been used as a broad policy expression for coordinated development across agriculture and allied sectors. It is not a scientific taxonomy or a single-crop revolution.
option_explanations_en: This reduces the scope to one crop.
This confuses it with protected cultivation.
questions.source_paragraph: Crops, horticulture, livestock, fisheries, food processing వంటి sectorsలో సమగ్ర వృద్ధి
options: Crops, horticulture, livestock, fisheries, food processing వంటి sectorsలో సమగ్ర వృద్ధి

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Term–meaning జతల్లో సరైనది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which term–meaning pairing is correct?
options_en: Golden Fibre—jute; Green Gold—a bamboo metaphor
questions.explanation_te: Juteను Golden Fibre అని విస్తృతంగా పిలుస్తారు; bambooను Green Goldగా metaphorically వాడవచ్చు. Silver Fibre–cotton వంటి labels source-sensitive; production methodను colour taxonomyగా చూడకూడదు.
questions.explanation_en: Jute is widely called the Golden Fibre; bamboo may be described metaphorically as Green Gold. Labels such as Silver Fibre–cotton are source-sensitive, and a production method is not a colour taxonomy.
option_explanations_en: A polyhouse is unrelated to capture fisheries.
questions.source_paragraph: Golden FibreJuteకు విస్తృతంగా వాడే nickname

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుటలు 488–489లోని Golden, Pink, Black, Brown colour labelsను score చేయడానికి సరైన నియమం ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct rule for scoring Golden, Pink, Black and Brown colour labels printed on pages 488–489?
options_te: Official question context లేదా dated authoritative source ఉన్నప్పుడు మాత్రమే definitive pairingగా వాడాలి
Printed tableలో ఉన్నందున అన్నీ universal scientific facts
ప్రతి colourకు multiple answersను ఒకేసారి correctగా mark చేయాలి
options_en: Use a definitive pairing only when supported by official question context or a dated authoritative source
Treat all printed pairs as universal scientific facts
Mark multiple products as correct for every colour simultaneously
questions.explanation_te: ఈ colour labels sourceల మధ్య మారుతాయి. Printed tableను preserve చేయాలి; కానీ source conflict ఉన్న pairను independent scored factగా చేయడం fair assessment కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: These colour labels vary among sources. The printed table should be preserved, but a source-conflicted pair should not become an independent scored fact.

questions.question_te: Natural Farming practicesను వాటి ప్రధాన functionsతో జతపరచండి. A. Beejamrit; B. Mulching; C. Waaphasa; D. Certified Organic Farming. 1. Seed treatment; 2. Soil cover; 3. Soil air–moisture balance; 4. Standards, inspection, certification.
questions.question_en: Match the terms with their principal functions. A. Beejamrit; B. Mulching; C. Waaphasa; D. Certified Organic Farming. 1. Seed treatment; 2. Soil cover; 3. Soil air–moisture balance; 4. Standards, inspection and certification.
questions.explanation_te: Beejamrit seed treatment; Mulching soil cover; Waaphasa soil air–moisture balanceపై దృష్టి; certified organic productionకు standards, inspection, certification ఉంటాయి.
questions.explanation_en: Beejamrit is a seed treatment; mulching is soil cover; Waaphasa focuses on soil air–moisture balance; certified organic production involves standards, inspection and certification.
option_explanations_en: Beejamrit and organic farming are interchanged.
questions.source_paragraph: బీజామృతం seed treatment; జీవామృతం soil/crop systemలో వాడే microbial preparation

questions.question_te: పుట 490లోని Beejamrit recipeను సరైన విధంగా ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి?
questions.question_en: How should the Beejamrit recipe printed on page 490 be used?
options_te: Printed practiceగా quantities/orderను నమోదు చేసి, efficacy–safety–crop suitabilityకు local guidance చూడాలి
ప్రతి seed diseaseకు guaranteed cureగా ప్రకటించాలి
Lime, urine quantitiesను ఏ cropకైనా స్వేచ్ఛగా మార్చాలి
options_en: Record the quantities and order as a printed practice, while using local guidance for efficacy, safety and crop suitability
Declare it a guaranteed cure for every seed disease
Use it as a soil fertiliser identical to Jeevamrit
Freely change lime and urine quantities for every crop
questions.explanation_te: Book recipe: 5 kg dung cloth bundle, 20 L water for 12 hours; 50 g lime in 1 L water overnight; dung extract with 5 L cow urine, bund soil and lime solution. Recipe evidence, universal efficacy వేరు.
questions.explanation_en: The book recipe uses a 5 kg dung cloth bundle in 20 L water for 12 hours; 50 g lime in 1 L water overnight; then dung extract, 5 L cow urine, bund soil and lime solution. A recipe and universal efficacy are different claims.
option_explanations_en: There is no evidence of a universal cure.
questions.source_paragraph: పుస్తకంలో 5 kg native-cow dungను clothలో కట్టి 20 L waterలో 12 hours ఉంచడం

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: ఆచ్ఛాదన (Mulching) గురించి statementsను పరిశీలించండి. 1. Evaporation తగ్గించవచ్చు. 2. Weed emergenceను అణచడంలో సహాయపడవచ్చు. 3. Organic mulch decompositionతో humusకు తోడ్పడవచ్చు. 4. అన్ని పరిస్థితుల్లో pest riskను పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements on mulching. 1. It can reduce evaporation. 2. It can help suppress weed emergence. 3. Decomposition of organic mulch can contribute to humus. 4. It completely removes pest risk in all situations. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: Mulchingకు moisture, weeds, temperature, organic matter benefits ఉండవచ్చు. Material, climate, pests, disease, decomposition conditionsను బట్టి outcome మారుతుంది; statement 4 తప్పు.
questions.explanation_en: Mulching can aid moisture conservation, weed suppression, temperature moderation and organic matter. Outcomes vary with material, climate, pests, disease and decomposition; statement 4 is false.
option_explanations_en: Statement 4 is false; statements 2 and 3 are also true.
All cannot be true because statement 4 is false.
questions.source_paragraph: Mulch material contaminatedగా ఉంటే pests, disease లేదా weed-seed risk ఉండవచ్చు.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Assertion (A): Rootsకు waterతో పాటు oxygen కూడా అవసరం. Reason (R): Waterloggingలో soil poresలో air-filled space తగ్గి root respirationకు ఆటంకం కలగవచ్చు.
questions.question_en: Assertion (A): Roots require oxygen as well as water. Reason (R): Waterlogging can reduce air-filled soil-pore space and hinder root respiration.
options_te: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు వివరణ కాదు
options_en: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.explanation_te: Waaphasa expression soil air–moisture balanceను గుర్తు చేస్తుంది. Water saturation ఎక్కువైతే gaseous exchange తగ్గి roots oxygen stressకు గురవవచ్చు. అయితే irrigation requirement crop–soil–weatherపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.
questions.explanation_en: The Waaphasa expression highlights soil air–moisture balance. Excess saturation can reduce gaseous exchange and cause root oxygen stress. Irrigation needs still depend on crop, soil and weather.
option_explanations_en: R explains the mechanism behind A.
questions.source_paragraph: Rootsకు oxygen, water రెండూ అవసరం; waterloggingలో air-filled pore space తగ్గుతుంది.
options: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు వివరణ కాదు

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: పుట 490లో Organic Farming గురించి ముద్రించిన statementsలో scientific correction అవసరమైనది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which printed statement on Organic Farming on page 490 requires scientific correction?
options_te: Organic Farming తప్పనిసరిగా Ex situ, inherently costly, Global Warmingకు కారణం
Certified organic systemsకు input standards, records, inspection ఉండవచ్చు
Natural and Organic Farmingకు కొన్ని ecological aims overlap కావచ్చు
options_en: Organic Farming is necessarily ex situ, inherently costly and a cause of global warming
Certified organic systems may have input standards, records and inspection
Biofertilisers and biopesticides may be used under permitted standards
Natural and Organic Farming may share some ecological aims
questions.explanation_te: Organic Farming ఒక field production system. Cost, labour, yield, emissions management, crop, regionను బట్టి మారతాయి. “Ex situ/inherently costly/causes warming” universal definition కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Organic Farming is a field production system. Cost, labour, yield and emissions vary by management, crop and region. “Ex situ, inherently costly and causes warming” is not a universal definition.
option_explanations_en: Correct; this blanket claim requires correction.
Goals may overlap, though the labels are not identical.
questions.source_paragraph: ఇవి universal definitions కావు.
options: Organic Farming తప్పనిసరిగా Ex situ, inherently costly, Global Warmingకు కారణం
Certified organic systemsకు input standards, records, inspection ఉండవచ్చు
Natural and Organic Farmingకు కొన్ని ecological aims overlap కావచ్చు

questions.question_te: Natural Farming, Certified Organic Farming మధ్య సరైన తేడా ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is a correct distinction between Natural Farming and certified Organic Farming?
options_te: Natural Farming local biological processes, farm-derived preparationsపై దృష్టి పెట్టవచ్చు; certified Organic Farming defined standards, inspection, certificationకు లోబడుతుంది
రెండూ ప్రతి recipe, input, certificationలో తప్పనిసరిగా identical
Organic Farmingలో biological inputs పూర్తిగా నిషేధం
Natural Farmingలో soil cover, crop diversityకు స్థానం లేదు
options_en: Natural Farming may emphasise local biological processes and farm-derived preparations; certified Organic Farming follows defined standards, inspection and certification
Both are necessarily identical in every recipe, input and certification rule
Biological inputs are completely prohibited in Organic Farming
Natural Farming has no place for soil cover or crop diversity
questions.explanation_te: Ecological aims overlap అయినా formal standards, input rules, certification, recommended preparationsలో తేడాలు ఉండవచ్చు. Label alone performance guarantee కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Although ecological aims can overlap, formal standards, input rules, certification and recommended preparations can differ. A label alone is not a performance guarantee.
option_explanations_en: These are practices discussed in Natural Farming.
questions.source_paragraph: Natural Farming, Organic Farmingలో ecological goals overlap కావచ్చు; కానీ input rules, certification, recommended preparations ఒకేలా ఉండవు.
options: Natural Farming local biological processes, farm-derived preparationsపై దృష్టి పెట్టవచ్చు; certified Organic Farming defined standards, inspection, certificationకు లోబడుతుంది
రెండూ ప్రతి recipe, input, certificationలో తప్పనిసరిగా identical
Organic Farmingలో biological inputs పూర్తిగా నిషేధం
Natural Farmingలో soil cover, crop diversityకు స్థానం లేదు

questions.question_te: Soil-management practiceను సాధ్యమైన benefitతో జతపరచండి. A. Compost/manure; B. Green manuring; C. Residue recycling; D. Reduced residue burning. 1. Organic matter and nutrients; 2. Biomass and nutrient cycling; 3. Carbon/nutrients returned to soil; 4. Less smoke and rapid nutrient loss.
questions.question_en: Match the soil-management practice with a possible benefit. A. Compost or manure; B. Green manuring; C. Residue recycling; D. Reduced residue burning. 1. Organic matter and nutrients; 2. Biomass and nutrient cycling; 3. Carbon and nutrients returned to soil; 4. Less smoke and rapid nutrient loss.
questions.explanation_te: Organic inputs nutrient cycling, soil organic matter, structure, biological activityకు సహాయపడవచ్చు. Benefit magnitude material quality, rate, timing, soil–crop conditionsను బట్టి మారుతుంది.
questions.explanation_en: Organic inputs can support nutrient cycling, soil organic matter, structure and biological activity. The magnitude depends on material quality, rate, timing and soil–crop conditions.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: 21వ పశుగణన (21st Livestock Census) గురించి statementsను పరిశీలించండి. 1. భారతదేశంలో మొదటి Livestock Census 1919లో జరిగింది. 2. సాధారణంగా ఐదేళ్లకొకసారి నిర్వహిస్తారు. 3. 21వ గణన 25 October 2024న ప్రారంభమైంది. 4. అది annual milk outputను నేరుగా కొలిచే survey. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about the 21st Livestock Census. 1. India conducted its first Livestock Census in 1919. 2. It is generally conducted once in five years. 3. The 21st census was launched on 25 October 2024. 4. It directly measures annual milk output. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: Livestock Census reference time వద్ద animal stockను లెక్కిస్తుంది. మొదటి గణన 1919; quinquennial cycle; 21వ గణన 25 October 2024న ప్రారంభమైంది. Annual milk output flow statistic; statement 4 తప్పు.
questions.explanation_en: The Livestock Census counts animal stock at a reference time. The first census was in 1919, the cycle is quinquennial, and the 21st was launched on 25 October 2024. Annual milk output is a flow statistic, so statement 4 is false.
option_explanations_en: Statement 4 is false; 2 and 3 are also true.
All cannot be correct because statement 4 is false.
questions.source_paragraph: 21వ గణన 25 October 2024న ప్రారంభమైంది.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Animal population, milk output, milk yield మధ్య సరైన సంబంధం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement correctly relates animal population, milk output and milk yield?
options_te: Animal population stock; output కాలవ్యవధి flow; yield ఒక animal లేదా unitకు productivity
ఎక్కువ cattle ఉన్న రాష్ట్రం తప్పనిసరిగా అత్యధిక milk yield కలిగి ఉంటుంది
Livestock Census annual milk outputనే లెక్కిస్తుంది
options_en: Animal population is a stock, output is a flow over a period, and yield is productivity per animal or unit
All three terms are the same indicator
The state with more cattle necessarily has the highest milk yield
The Livestock Census counts only annual milk output
questions.explanation_te: Population, output, productivityను వేరు చేయాలి. ఎక్కువ animalsతో total output పెరగవచ్చు; కానీ yield breed, feed, health, managementపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.
questions.explanation_en: Population, output and productivity must be distinguished. More animals may raise total output, but yield depends on breed, feed, health and management.
option_explanations_en: The census is a stock count.
questions.source_paragraph: Animal population, total output, yield per animal—మూడు వేర్వేరు indicators.
options: Animal population stock; output కాలవ్యవధి flow; yield ఒక animal లేదా unitకు productivity
ఎక్కువ cattle ఉన్న రాష్ట్రం తప్పనిసరిగా అత్యధిక milk yield కలిగి ఉంటుంది
Livestock Census annual milk outputనే లెక్కిస్తుంది

questions.question_te: Cattle breed classification గురించి statementsను పరిశీలించండి. 1. Home tract అంటే breed చారిత్రకంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన ప్రధాన ప్రాంతం. 2. Breed కనిపించే ప్రతి రాష్ట్రం దాని home tract. 3. Milch, draught, dual-purpose functional groupings. 4. Tharparkar, Kankrej, Hariana సాధారణంగా dual-purposeగా బోధిస్తారు. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about cattle-breed classification. 1. Home tract is the principal area where a breed historically developed. 2. Every state where a breed occurs is its home tract. 3. Milch, draught and dual-purpose are functional groupings. 4. Tharparkar, Kankrej and Hariana are commonly taught as dual-purpose breeds. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: Occurrence, home tract ఒకటి కాదు; statement 2 తప్పు. మిగిలిన మూడు సరైన conceptual distinctions.
questions.explanation_en: Occurrence and home tract are not identical, so statement 2 is false. The other three are correct conceptual distinctions.
option_explanations_en: Statement 2 is false; 3 and 4 are also true.
All cannot be true because statement 2 is false.
questions.source_paragraph: Home tract అంటే ఆ breed చారిత్రకంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన ప్రధాన భౌగోళిక ప్రాంతం

questions.question_en: What is essential before using the global milk, egg and meat shares printed on page 491 as exam facts?
options_te: Reference year, source, product definition, denominatorను నిర్ధారించడం
Milk shareను animal population shareగా మార్చడం
Egg rankతో meat rankను infer చేయడం
options_en: Verify the reference year, source, product definition and denominator
Treat the percentages as permanently current because they are percentages
Convert milk share into animal-population share
Infer the meat rank from the egg rank
questions.explanation_te: Global shares కాలానుగుణం. Milk, eggs, meatకు వేర్వేరు datasets, units, years ఉంటాయి. Source year లేకుండా printed percentageను current scored factగా వాడరాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Global shares are time-bound. Milk, eggs and meat use different datasets, units and years. A printed percentage without its source year should not be used as a current scored fact.
questions.source_paragraph: పుట 491లోని dated claims
options: Reference year, source, product definition, denominatorను నిర్ధారించడం

Egg rankతో meat rankను infer చేయడం

questions.question_te: “కొన్ని దేశాల్లో cow రోజుకు 30–40 L, Indiaలో 1 L” అనే printed comparisonలో ప్రధాన సమస్య ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the main problem with the printed comparison “30–40 L per cow per day in some countries versus 1 L in India”?
options_te: Breed, lactation stage, milking-animal denominator, year, production system తెలియవు
Daily yieldకు feed, health ప్రభావం ఉండదు
Country average ఎప్పుడూ best-herd yieldతో సమానం
options_en: Breed, lactation stage, milking-animal denominator, year and production system are unspecified
Litres can never be used in dairying
Feed and health do not affect daily yield
A country average always equals the best-herd yield
questions.explanation_te: Yield comparisonకు same denominator, period, animal category, lactation status అవసరం. Best animalsను national averageతో పోలిస్తే misleading result వస్తుంది.
questions.explanation_en: A yield comparison requires the same denominator, period, animal category and lactation status. Comparing selected high-performing animals with a national average is misleading.
option_explanations_en: The unit alone is not the problem.
questions.source_paragraph: Animal population, total output, yield per animal—మూడు వేర్వేరు indicators.
options: Breed, lactation stage, milking-animal denominator, year, production system తెలియవు
Daily yieldకు feed, health ప్రభావం ఉండదు
Country average ఎప్పుడూ best-herd yieldతో సమానం

options_te: Crossbredకు గుర్తించిన parental-breed ancestry ఉంటుంది; Exotic breed మూలం భారతదేశం వెలుపల

Both are necessarily the same breed
An exotic breed necessarily developed in an Indian indigenous home tract
questions.explanation_te: Crossbred అనేది breeding ancestry; exotic అనేది geographic origin భావన. Karan Swiss, Karan Fries NDRI crossbred strains; Jersey, Holstein Friesian exotic dairy breeds.
questions.explanation_en: Crossbred describes breeding ancestry, whereas exotic describes geographic origin. Karan Swiss and Karan Fries are NDRI crossbred strains; Jersey and Holstein Friesian are exotic dairy breeds.
questions.source_paragraph: Crossbred animalలో గుర్తించిన వేర్వేరు parental breeds ancestry ఉంటుంది.
options: Crossbredకు గుర్తించిన parental-breed ancestry ఉంటుంది; Exotic breed మూలం భారతదేశం వెలుపల

questions.explanation_te: AI method; sex-sorted semen input; breed heritable population; home tract geographic history.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: Livestock-sector PPPను evaluate చేయడానికి సరైన framework ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct framework for evaluating a livestock-sector PPP?
options_te: Roles, service standards, price, access, accountability, outcomes
Private partner ఉన్నందున public oversight అవసరం లేదు
options_en: Roles, service standards, price, access, accountability and outcomes
The PPP label alone guarantees success
A private partner eliminates the need for public oversight
The subsidy rate alone is the outcome
questions.explanation_te: PPP institutional arrangement. Access, quality, accountability, affordability, outcome monitoring లేకుండా label alone evidence కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: A PPP is an institutional arrangement. The label alone is not evidence without access, quality, accountability, affordability and outcome monitoring.
questions.source_paragraph: PPP అనే label alone outcome guarantee కాదు.
options: Roles, service standards, price, access, accountability, outcomes
Private partner ఉన్నందున public oversight అవసరం లేదు

questions.question_en: Match the AP-associated breed/species pairs. A. Ongole; B. Punganur; C. Nellore; D. Aseel. 1. Cattle; 2. Cattle; 3. Sheep; 4. Chicken.
questions.explanation_te: Ongole, Punganur cattle; Nellore sheep; Aseel chicken. Species distinction conservationకు basic.

option_explanations_en: The unit is not the problem.

questions.question_en: What is needed before scoring the claim that 62.54 lakh of 126.65 lakh households (49.38%) depend on livestock-related livelihoods?

Treating a crore head count as egg output
Comparing it with a cattle census

questions.question_te: Marine, freshwater fish production rowsను సరైన విధంగా ఎలా చదవాలి?

Marine rankతో milk rankను infer చేయాలి
options_en: Read environment/category, year, tonnes and district boundary separately
Treat both as an identical production system
Treat prawn output as fish population
Infer milk rank from marine rank

questions.explanation_en: The source classification must distinguish marine and freshwater categories; tonnes represent output over a period.
questions.source_paragraph: Marine fish and prawns

Marine rankతో milk rankను infer చేయాలి

The rank order has three districts

options_te: Eggs సాధారణంగా number/countతో report అవుతాయి; unit/source verify చేయాలి

Eggs and meat are the same indicator

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: CAA గురించి statementsను పరిశీలించండి. 1. Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005 కింద ఏర్పడింది. 2. Act 2023లో amended అయింది. 3. Registration, environmental regulation functions ఉన్నాయి. 4. Freshwater aquaculture అంతా automaticగా CAA coastal aquaculture. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about CAA. 1. It was established under the Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005. 2. The Act was amended in 2023. 3. It has registration and environmental-regulation functions. 4. All freshwater aquaculture is automatically coastal aquaculture under CAA. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: CAA coastal saline/brackish aquaculture regulationకు. Principal Act 2005; amendment 2023. Freshwater aquaculture definitionలో automaticగా చేరదు.
questions.explanation_en: CAA regulates coastal saline/brackish aquaculture. The principal Act is from 2005 and was amended in 2023. Freshwater aquaculture is not automatically included.
option_explanations_en: Statement 4 is false; 2 and 3 are true.
All cannot be correct because 4 is false.
questions.source_paragraph: Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: CAA purviewలో “HTL నుంచి 2 km” అన్నదాని సరైన interpretation ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct interpretation of “2 km from HTL” in the CAA context?
options_te: Notified coastal regulatory purview; free permission కాదు, other restrictions/exceptions apply
options_en: A notified coastal regulatory purview, not free permission; other restrictions and exceptions apply
An unconditional right to aquaculture anywhere within 2 km
The radius of a freshwater tank
questions.explanation_te: Jurisdiction, permission ఒకటి కాదు. 200 m restriction, hatchery exemption, CRZ, registration requirements separately apply.
questions.explanation_en: Jurisdiction and permission are not identical. The 200 m restriction, hatchery exemption, CRZ and registration requirements apply separately.
questions.source_paragraph: 2 km వరకు regulation
options: Notified coastal regulatory purview; free permission కాదు, other restrictions/exceptions apply

questions.question_te: Fisheries systemsను descriptionsతో జతపరచండి. A. Marine capture; B. Inland capture; C. Freshwater aquaculture; D. Brackish-water shrimp culture. 1. Sea wild stocks; 2. Inland wild stocks; 3. Managed freshwater farming; 4. Managed intermediate-salinity farming.
questions.question_en: Match fisheries systems with their descriptions. A. Marine capture; B. Inland capture; C. Freshwater aquaculture; D. Brackish-water shrimp culture. 1. Sea wild stocks; 2. Inland wild stocks; 3. Managed freshwater farming; 4. Managed intermediate-salinity farming.
questions.explanation_te: Capture wild stocks; aquaculture managed rearing. Marine, freshwater, brackish environmentsను వేరు చేయాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Capture uses wild stocks, while aquaculture involves managed rearing. Marine, freshwater and brackish environments must be distinguished.
questions.source_paragraph: Marine capture, inland capture, freshwater aquaculture

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not a previous-year question
questions.question_te: AP Maritime Policy 2024 Phase-1 fishing harboursను గుర్తించండి. A. Juvvaladinne; B. Uppada; C. Machilipatnam; D. Nizampatnam.

questions.explanation_en: All four are in the policy Phase-1 list. Listing and commissioning status must be treated separately.

B and D are also included.

questions.question_en: How should fishing-harbour project statuses be distinguished?
options_en: Listed/proposed, sanctioned, under construction and commissioned

questions.source_paragraph: Harbour “listed”, “sanctioned”, “under construction”, “commissioned” statuses ఒకటి కాదు.
